    - name: int_app_health_metrics
      description: Unified daily app health metrics across Google Play and Apple Store with crashes, installs, ratings, rolling stats, trends, scores, classifications, flags, and data quality
      grain: One row per app_name per platform per date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_crashes_overview
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_installs_overview
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_ratings_overview
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_crash_daily
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_download_standard_daily
      business_logic: 'Inputs and key mapping: - Crashes: - Google Play: stg_google_play__stats_crashes_overview (date_day, package_name→app_name, crashes) - Apple Store: stg_apple_store__app_crash_daily (date_day, app_name, crashes) - Installs/Downloads: - Google Play: stg_google_play__stats_installs_overview (date_day, package_name→app_name, device_installs, device_uninstalls) - Apple Store: stg_apple_store__app_store_download_standard_daily (date_day, app_name, total_downloads) - Ratings: - Google Play only: stg_google_play__stats_ratings_overview (date_day, package_name→app_name, average_rating, rolling_total_average_rating), including only rows where average_rating is present (rows with NULL average_rating are excluded). - Platform is set to ''google_play'' or ''apple_store'' per source row. Record assembly (full outer joins; assumes sources are unique per (date_day, app_name, platform)): - Full outer join crashes and installs on (date_day, app_name, platform). - Full outer join ratings using the coalesced (date_day, app_name, platform) from the prior join. - Coalesced keys: date_day = coalesce(crashes.date_day, installs.date_day, ratings.date_day); app_name and platform likewise. Metrics null policy: - crash_count = coalesce(source crashes, 0). - Installs/uninstalls/total_activity: - Google Play: installs = device_installs; uninstalls = device_uninstalls; total_activity = installs + uninstalls. - Apple Store: installs = total_downloads; uninstalls = 0; total_activity = installs. - daily_average_rating and total_average_rating come from Google Play ratings; they are NULL when no rating row exists. Rate calculations (double precision; no rounding): - crash_rate_per_thousand = crashes per 1,000 activities using crash_count and total_activity; if total_activity is 0 or missing, set to 0. - uninstall_rate_percentage = uninstalls as a percent of installs; if installs is 0 or missing, set to 0. Rolling windows and lags (partitioned by app_name and platform; ordered by date_day; row-based using available records only): - 7-row averages: crash_rate_7d_avg = average of crash_rate_per_thousand over up to the last 7 records (including current); uninstall_rate_7d_avg = average of uninstall_rate_percentage over the same; rating_7d_avg = average of daily_average_rating over the same (NULL if all values in the window are NULL). - 30-row metrics: crash_rate_30d_avg = average of crash_rate_per_thousand over up to the last 30 records; installs_30d_sum = sum of installs over up to the last 30 records; crashes_30d_sum = sum of crash_count over up to the last 30 records. - Lags: rating_7d_ago and crash_rate_7d_ago are the values from 7 records earlier. Trends (default to 0 when insufficient history or NULL inputs): - rating_trend_7d = daily_average_rating minus rating_7d_ago when both exist; else 0. - crash_rate_trend_7d = crash_rate_per_thousand minus crash_rate_7d_ago when both exist; else 0. Health score (integer 0–100): - Start at 50. - Rating adjustment using daily_average_rating: +30 (≥4.5), +20 (≥4.0), +10 (≥3.5), +0 (≥3.0), -10 otherwise; if rating is missing it falls to the -10 adjustment. - Crash-rate penalty using crash_rate_7d_avg: 0 (≤1), -5 (≤5), -10 (≤10), -15 (≤20), -20 otherwise. - Uninstall-rate penalty using uninstall_rate_7d_avg: 0 (≤2), -5 (≤5), -10 (≤10), -15 (≤20), -20 otherwise. - Bound the final score to 0–100. Health status (first-match precedence): - Critical if crash_rate_7d_avg > 15. - High Risk if uninstall_rate_7d_avg > 15. - Poor Quality if daily_average_rating < 3.0. - Declining if rating_trend_7d < -0.3. - Unstable if crash_rate_trend_7d > 5. - Excellent if daily_average_rating ≥ 4.0 and crash_rate_7d_avg ≤ 5. - Good if daily_average_rating ≥ 3.5 and crash_rate_7d_avg ≤ 10. - Average otherwise. Volume tier by installs_30d_sum: - High Volume (≥10,000), Medium Volume (≥1,000), Low Volume (≥100), Minimal Volume (<100). Flags (0/1 integers): - needs_immediate_attention = 1 for health_status in (''Critical'',''High Risk''); else 0. - is_high_performing = 1 for health_status=''Excellent''; else 0. - is_declining_quality = 1 if rating_trend_7d < -0.2; else 0. - is_stability_degrading = 1 if crash_rate_trend_7d > 3; else 0. Data quality flag (first-match precedence): - Invalid Health Score if health_score < 0 or > 100. - Invalid Crash Rate if crash_rate_per_thousand < 0. - Invalid Uninstall Rate if uninstall_rate_percentage < 0. - Invalid Rating if daily_average_rating < 0 or > 5. - Valid otherwise. Output filter and timestamp: - Include only rows where date_day, app_name, and platform are not NULL. - analysis_timestamp = current runtime timestamp in the warehouse/session time zone.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Metric date for the aggregated daily health record
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier; Google uses package_name mapped to app_name; Apple uses app_name as-is
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Source platform literal identifying the ecosystem: ''google_play'' or ''apple_store'''
        tests:
        - not_null
        - platform IN ('google_play','apple_store')
      - name: crash_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily crashes from source data, set to 0 when missing
        tests:
        - not_null
        - crash_count >= 0
      - name: installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Daily installs/downloads (Google: device_installs; Apple: total_downloads) set to 0 when missing'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - installs >= 0
      - name: uninstalls
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily uninstalls (Google only) else 0 for Apple and when missing
        tests:
        - not_null
        - uninstalls >= 0
      - name: total_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Activity denominator (Google: installs+uninstalls; Apple: installs) set to 0 when missing'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - total_activity >= 0
      - name: daily_average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(10,2)
        description: Google Play daily average rating; NULL if no rating row; intended range 0–5 with 2-decimal precision
      - name: total_average_rating
        data_type: DECIMAL(10,2)
        description: Google Play rolling total average rating; NULL if absent; intended range 0–5 with 2-decimal precision
      - name: crash_rate_per_thousand
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Crashes per 1,000 activities using crash_count and total_activity; set to 0 when total_activity is 0 or missing
        tests:
        - not_null
        - crash_rate_per_thousand >= 0
      - name: uninstall_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Uninstalls as a percent of installs; set to 0 when installs is 0 or missing; can exceed 100% when uninstalls > installs
        tests:
        - not_null
        - uninstall_rate_percentage >= 0 AND uninstall_rate_percentage <= 100
      - name: crash_rate_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling average of crash_rate_per_thousand over up to the last 7 records by app/platform; non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
        - crash_rate_7d_avg >= 0
      - name: uninstall_rate_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling average of uninstall_rate_percentage over up to the last 7 records by app/platform; non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
        - uninstall_rate_7d_avg >= 0
      - name: rating_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling average of daily_average_rating over up to the last 7 records by app/platform; NULL if the window has no ratings
      - name: crash_rate_30d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling average of crash_rate_per_thousand over up to the last 30 records by app/platform; non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
        - crash_rate_30d_avg >= 0
      - name: installs_30d_sum
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Rolling sum of installs over up to the last 30 records by app/platform; non-null and non-negative
        tests:
        - not_null
        - installs_30d_sum >= 0
      - name: crashes_30d_sum
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Rolling sum of crash_count over up to the last 30 records by app/platform; non-null and non-negative
        tests:
        - not_null
        - crashes_30d_sum >= 0
      - name: rating_trend_7d
        data_type: DECIMAL(12,2)
        description: Change in rating versus the value from 7 records earlier; 0 if missing history or inputs
        tests:
        - not_null
        - rating_trend_7d >= -5.00 AND rating_trend_7d <= 5.00
      - name: crash_rate_trend_7d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Change in crash_rate_per_thousand versus the value from 7 records earlier; 0 if missing history or inputs
      - name: health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Composite score 0–100 from base 50 plus rating adjustment and penalties based on 7-row averages; bounded to [0,100]
        tests:
        - not_null
        - health_score >= 0 AND health_score <= 100
      - name: health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Categorical status from ordered rules using crash/uninstall 7-row averages, rating, and trends
        tests:
        - not_null
        - health_status IN ('Critical','High Risk','Poor Quality','Declining','Unstable','Excellent','Good','Average')
      - name: volume_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Usage volume class by installs_30d_sum thresholds: High (≥10000), Medium (≥1000), Low (≥100), Minimal (<100)'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - volume_tier IN ('High Volume','Medium Volume','Low Volume','Minimal Volume')
      - name: needs_immediate_attention
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Urgency flag as 0/1 where 1 for health_status in ('Critical','High Risk')
        tests:
        - not_null
        - needs_immediate_attention IN (0,1)
      - name: is_high_performing
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Performance flag as 0/1 where 1 for health_status='Excellent'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - is_high_performing IN (0,1)
      - name: is_declining_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Trend flag as 0/1 where 1 if rating_trend_7d < -0.2
        tests:
        - not_null
        - is_declining_quality IN (0,1)
      - name: is_stability_degrading
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Stability flag as 0/1 where 1 if crash_rate_trend_7d > 3
        tests:
        - not_null
        - is_stability_degrading IN (0,1)
      - name: data_quality_flag
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Quality check result with precedence: Invalid Health Score, Invalid Crash Rate, Invalid Uninstall Rate, Invalid Rating, else Valid'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - data_quality_flag IN ('Valid','Invalid Health Score','Invalid Crash Rate','Invalid Uninstall Rate','Invalid Rating')
      - name: analysis_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Runtime timestamp set via current_timestamp in warehouse/session time zone
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: int_channel_performance
      description: Unified daily channel performance metrics by app, platform, and traffic source across Google Play and Apple App Store
      grain: One row per date_day, app_name, platform, traffic_source
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_play__stats_store_performance_traffic_source
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_discovery_and_engagement_standard_daily
      business_logic: 'Data unification - Google Play: use date_day, package_name as app_name, traffic_source, acquisitions as both conversions and installers, visitors as store_visitors; treat NULL inputs as 0; set platform to "google_play". - Apple: use date_day, app_name, source_type as traffic_source, page_views as both store_visitors and installers; set conversions to 0; treat NULL inputs as 0; set platform to "apple_store". - Combine both sources without deduplication; keep one output row per input row. Daily metrics and categorization - For each row: conversion_rate_percentage = installers × 100 / store_visitors; if store_visitors is 0 then 0. - install_per_conversion_ratio = installers / conversions; if conversions is 0 then 0. - channel_category from traffic_source (after lowercasing): - contains "search" → "Organic Search" - contains "referr" → "Referral" - contains "ad" or "campaign" → "Paid Advertising" - contains "social" → "Social Media" - contains "email" → "Email Marketing" - contains "direct" → "Direct" - otherwise "Other". Rolling windows and prior values (per app_name, platform, traffic_source, ordered by date_day ascending; fixed-size windows over rows, not calendar gaps) - 7-row window (current day and previous 6 rows): conversion_rate_7d_avg is the average of conversion_rate_percentage; installers_7d_sum is the sum of installers; visitors_7d_sum is the sum of store_visitors. - 30-row window (current day and previous 29 rows): conversion_rate_30d_avg is the average of conversion_rate_percentage; installers_30d_sum and visitors_30d_sum are the sums over the same window. - Prior values: use the values from 7 rows earlier for conversion_rate_percentage and installers. - conversion_trend_7d = current conversion_rate_percentage minus the value from 7 rows earlier; if the prior value is missing then 0 (units: percentage points). - installer_growth_7d_percentage = percentage change vs the installers value from 7 rows earlier; if the prior installers ≤ 0 or missing then 0. Daily rankings and market share (within each app and platform on the same date) - volume_rank_daily: position when sorting channels by installers descending; ties resolve arbitrarily. - conversion_rank_daily: position when sorting by conversion_rate_percentage descending; ties resolve arbitrarily. - volume_rank_30d: position when sorting by installers_30d_sum descending; ties resolve arbitrarily. - conversion_rank_30d: position when sorting by conversion_rate_30d_avg descending; ties resolve arbitrarily. - market_share_percentage: installers as a percentage of the total installers for the same app, platform, and date; if the group total is 0 then 0. Scoring, tiering, and recommendations - channel_efficiency_score (0–100): base score of 40 plus boosts: - conversion_rate_30d_avg: ≥10 → +30; ≥5 → +20; ≥2 → +10; ≥1 → +5; otherwise +0 - installers_30d_sum: ≥1000 → +20; ≥500 → +15; ≥100 → +10; ≥50 → +5; otherwise +0 - stability: if conversion_trend_7d ≥ -0.5 and installer_growth_7d_percentage ≥ -10 → +10; else if conversion_trend_7d ≥ -1.0 and installer_growth_7d_percentage ≥ -20 → +5; otherwise +0 - final score is capped between 0 and 100. - channel_performance_tier: - if conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 5 and installers_30d_sum ≥ 100 → "High Performer" - else if conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 2 and installers_30d_sum ≥ 50 → "Solid Performer" - else if conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 1 or installers_30d_sum ≥ 20 → "Average Performer" - else if installers_30d_sum > 0 → "Low Performer" - else → "No Activity". - investment_recommendation: - if channel_efficiency_score ≥ 80 and installer_growth_7d_percentage ≥ 0 → "Scale Up" - else if channel_efficiency_score ≥ 60 and conversion_trend_7d ≥ 0 → "Optimize" - else if channel_efficiency_score ≥ 40 → "Monitor" - else if installers_30d_sum > 0 → "Review" - else → "Consider Pause". Flags, data quality, and timestamp - is_top_channel = 1 if channel_performance_tier is "High Performer", else 0. - should_scale_up = 1 if investment_recommendation is "Scale Up", else 0. - is_declining_performance = 1 if conversion_trend_7d < -2.0 percentage points, else 0. - is_top_volume_source = 1 if volume_rank_daily = 1, else 0. - data_quality_flag (first matching rule wins): invalid conversion rate (<0 or >100) → "Invalid Conversion Rate"; else invalid efficiency score (<0 or >100) → "Invalid Efficiency Score"; else invalid market share (<0 or >100) → "Invalid Market Share"; else negative installers or store_visitors → "Invalid Volume Metrics"; else "Valid". - analysis_timestamp is the current timestamp when the model runs (time zone aware). - Final filter keeps only rows with non-null date_day, app_name, platform, and traffic_source.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the metrics row
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Application identifier (Google: package_name; Apple: app_name)'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Source platform label: ''google_play'' or ''apple_store'''
        tests:
        - not_null
        - platform IN ('google_play','apple_store')
      - name: traffic_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Platform-provided source label (Google: traffic_source; Apple: source_type)'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: channel_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from traffic_source (lowercased): contains search → Organic Search; referr → Referral; ad or campaign → Paid Advertising; social → Social Media; email → Email Marketing; direct → Direct; else Other'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - channel_category IN ('Organic Search','Referral','Paid Advertising','Social Media','Email Marketing','Direct','Other')
      - name: conversions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of acquisitions (Google uses store_listing_acquisitions; Apple is 0); NULL inputs treated as 0
        tests:
        - conversions >= 0
      - name: store_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Store listing/page views (Google: store_listing_visitors; Apple: page_views); NULL inputs treated as 0'
        tests:
        - store_visitors >= 0
      - name: installers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Installer proxy (Google: acquisitions; Apple: page_views); NULL inputs treated as 0'
        tests:
        - installers >= 0
      - name: conversion_rate_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Installers × 100 divided by store_visitors, with 0 when store_visitors is 0 (units: %)'
        tests:
        - conversion_rate_percentage >= 0
        - conversion_rate_percentage <= 100
      - name: install_per_conversion_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Installers divided by conversions, with 0 when conversions is 0
        tests:
        - install_per_conversion_ratio >= 0
      - name: market_share_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of installers within the same app, platform, and date (0 when the group total is 0)
        tests:
        - market_share_percentage >= 0
        - market_share_percentage <= 100
      - name: channel_efficiency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score from 0 to 100 based on 30d conversion rate, 30d installers, and 7d stability; capped to 0–100
        tests:
        - not_null
        - channel_efficiency_score >= 0
        - channel_efficiency_score <= 100
      - name: conversion_rate_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-row rolling average of conversion_rate_percentage within app+platform+traffic_source ordered by date
        tests:
        - conversion_rate_7d_avg >= 0
      - name: installers_7d_sum
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 7-row rolling sum of installers within app+platform+traffic_source ordered by date
        tests:
        - installers_7d_sum >= 0
      - name: visitors_7d_sum
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 7-row rolling sum of store_visitors within app+platform+traffic_source ordered by date
        tests:
        - visitors_7d_sum >= 0
      - name: conversion_rate_30d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 30-row rolling average of conversion_rate_percentage within app+platform+traffic_source ordered by date
        tests:
        - conversion_rate_30d_avg >= 0
      - name: installers_30d_sum
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 30-row rolling sum of installers within app+platform+traffic_source ordered by date
        tests:
        - installers_30d_sum >= 0
      - name: visitors_30d_sum
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 30-row rolling sum of store_visitors within app+platform+traffic_source ordered by date
        tests:
        - visitors_30d_sum >= 0
      - name: conversion_trend_7d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Difference from the value 7 rows earlier; 0 when the prior value is missing (units: percentage points)'
      - name: installer_growth_7d_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage change vs installers 7 rows earlier; 0 if the prior installers is ≤ 0 or missing
      - name: volume_rank_daily
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Position within app+platform+date when sorted by installers descending; ties arbitrary
        tests:
        - volume_rank_daily >= 1
      - name: conversion_rank_daily
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Position within app+platform+date when sorted by conversion_rate_percentage descending; ties arbitrary
        tests:
        - conversion_rank_daily >= 1
      - name: volume_rank_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Position within app+platform+date when sorted by installers_30d_sum descending; ties arbitrary
        tests:
        - volume_rank_30d >= 1
      - name: conversion_rank_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Position within app+platform+date when sorted by conversion_rate_30d_avg descending; ties arbitrary
        tests:
        - conversion_rank_30d >= 1
      - name: channel_performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier from 30d conversion rate and installer thresholds: High, Solid, Average, Low, or No Activity'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - channel_performance_tier IN ('High Performer','Solid Performer','Average Performer','Low Performer','No Activity')
      - name: investment_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recommendation based on efficiency score and short-term trends: Scale Up, Optimize, Monitor, Review, or Consider Pause'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - investment_recommendation IN ('Scale Up','Optimize','Monitor','Review','Consider Pause')
      - name: is_top_channel
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if channel_performance_tier is 'High Performer', else 0
        tests:
        - not_null
        - is_top_channel IN (0,1)
      - name: should_scale_up
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if investment_recommendation is 'Scale Up', else 0
        tests:
        - not_null
        - should_scale_up IN (0,1)
      - name: is_declining_performance
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if conversion_trend_7d < -2.0 percentage points, else 0
        tests:
        - not_null
        - is_declining_performance IN (0,1)
      - name: is_top_volume_source
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if volume_rank_daily equals 1, else 0
        tests:
        - not_null
        - is_top_volume_source IN (0,1)
      - name: data_quality_flag
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Validation result with precedence: invalid conversion rate, then efficiency score, then market share, then volume metrics, else Valid'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - data_quality_flag IN ('Valid','Invalid Conversion Rate','Invalid Efficiency Score','Invalid Market Share','Invalid Volume Metrics')
      - name: analysis_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the analysis was executed (time zone aware)
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: int_apple_store__app_version
      description: Daily Apple Store app-version metrics merged from downloads, installations/deletions, and crashes; metrics include deletions and crashes, downloads provide keys only.
      grain: One row per source_relation + date_day + app_name + app_version
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_download_standard_daily
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_installation_and_deletion_standard_daily
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_crash_daily
      business_logic: '- Define the key as (source_relation, date_day, app_name, app_version). - Per key: - Downloads: sum total_downloads; used only to supply key presence. - Installations/Deletions: sum counts where event_type is install (not returned) and where event_type is delete as deletions. - Crashes: sum crash counts as crashes. - Merge the three sources so every key present in any source is included. - For each key field in the merged row, take the first available non-null value preferring downloads, then installations/deletions, then crashes; preserve original casing and spacing. - Outputs: app_platform is set to apple_store; missing deletions default to 0; missing crashes default to 0. - Aggregations remove duplicates within each source; no sorting or additional filtering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Key field taken from downloads when available, otherwise from installations/deletions, otherwise from crashes.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar day for the key, selected with the same source preference as source_relation.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant value apple_store for all rows.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: App name for the key, selected with the same source preference as source_relation.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_version
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: App version for the key, selected with the same source preference as source_relation.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: deletions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total delete events per key from installation/deletion data; if absent, set to 0.
        tests:
        - deletions >= 0
      - name: crashes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total crashes per key from crash data; if absent, set to 0.
        tests:
        - crashes >= 0
    - name: int_apple_store__country
      description: Daily Apple Store downloads and deletions aggregated per app and country; platform is constant 'apple_store' and install/uninstall/update event columns are set to 0.
      grain: One row per unique combination of source_relation, app_name, country, and date_day from either input
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_download_standard_daily
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_installation_and_deletion_standard_daily
      business_logic: '- Build downloads: - Group by source_relation, date_day, app_name, country. - For each group, sum total_downloads; NULL values do not contribute to the sum. - Build installation/deletion aggregates: - Group by the same keys. - For each group, sum counts for rows where event_type equals ''install'' into installs, and for rows where event_type equals ''delete'' into deletions; NULL counts do not contribute. - String comparisons for event_type are exact matches to ''install'' and ''delete''. - Merge the two aggregates with a full outer join on the four keys so all key combinations present in either input are included. - For each merged group: - Keys (source_relation, date_day, app_name, country) are taken from whichever input provides them; if present in both, they are identical. - app_platform is the literal ''apple_store''. - downloads is the summed downloads for the group; if no downloads exist for the group, set to 0. - deletions is the summed deletions for the group; if no deletions exist for the group, set to 0. - install_events, uninstall_events, and update_events are set to 0 for all rows. - Determinism and handling: - Summations aggregate all rows within each group; duplicates within a group are included in the totals. - Numeric NULLs are ignored in summations; metrics default to 0 when the corresponding input is missing. - Text fields preserve original casing and spacing; no trimming, normalization, or sorting is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier taken from whichever input provides it during the merge; preserved as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date taken from whichever input provides it during the merge.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant string 'apple_store' for all rows.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: App name taken from whichever input provides it; original casing is preserved.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country value taken from whichever input provides it; original value is preserved.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total downloads summed per group; defaults to 0 when no downloads exist for the group.
        tests:
        - downloads >= 0
      - name: deletions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total deletions summed from rows with event_type 'delete' per group; defaults to 0 when absent.
        tests:
        - deletions >= 0
      - name: install_events
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always 0 for all rows.
        tests:
        - install_events >= 0
      - name: uninstall_events
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always 0 for all rows.
        tests:
        - uninstall_events >= 0
      - name: update_events
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always 0 for all rows.
        tests:
        - update_events >= 0
    - name: int_apple_store__device
      description: Device-level Apple Store downloads and deletions per app/day/device from the union of download and installation/deletion sources
      grain: One row per (source_relation, date_day, app_name, device)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_download_standard_daily
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_installation_and_deletion_standard_daily
      business_logic: '- Aggregate downloads by (source_relation, date_day, app_name, device) from staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_download_standard_daily by summing total_downloads; NULL values are skipped by the aggregation. - Aggregate installation/deletion events by the same keys from staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_installation_and_deletion_standard_daily: - deletions: sum counts only for rows where event_type is ''delete''; other event types contribute 0; NULL counts do not contribute. - installs are also summed (for ''install'') but not used in the final output. - Merge the two aggregates with a full outer join on (source_relation, date_day, app_name, device) so all keys present in either source are retained. - Output fields: - source_relation, date_day, app_name, device: taken from whichever side is present; if the originating value is NULL on the only present side, it remains NULL. - app_platform: constant ''apple_store''. - downloads: if the downloads aggregate is missing or null for the key, set to 0; otherwise use the aggregated sum. - deletions: if the deletions aggregate is missing or null for the key, set to 0; otherwise use the aggregated sum. - Determinism: - All records per key are included in the aggregations; no filtering, deduplication, or ordering is applied. - The full outer join retains all keys from both sources; for text fields, original casing and spacing are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source feed identifier used in grouping; taken from the side present after the merge; may be NULL if the source value is NULL
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of aggregation; taken from the side present after the merge; may be NULL if the source value is NULL
      - name: app_platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant value 'apple_store' for all rows
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name as provided by sources; taken from the side present after the merge; may be NULL if the source value is NULL
      - name: device
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Device type from Apple Store data; taken from the side present after the merge; may be NULL if the source value is NULL
      - name: downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total downloads per key; aggregates total_downloads with NULL inputs skipped; defaults to 0 if no downloads data or only NULL values exist
      - name: deletions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total deletions per key; sums counts for delete events (others add 0) with NULL counts skipped; defaults to 0 if no delete data or only NULL values exist
    - name: int_apple_store__os_version
      description: Apple Store OS-version downloads and deletions by app per day
      grain: One row per source_relation + app_name + os_version + date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_download_standard_daily
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_installation_and_deletion_standard_daily
      business_logic: '- Build downloads_by_os: - From the downloads source, for each (source_relation, date_day, app_name, platform_version), add all total_downloads to produce one total per key. - Build installations_deletions: - From the installation/deletion source, for the same keys, add counts from rows where event_type is delete to produce one total per key. Counts from rows where event_type is install are also tallied but not used in the final output. - Combine: - Full outer join the two aggregates on the four keys to retain every key present in either source. - Output mapping: - source_relation, date_day, app_name, os_version: take values from the downloads side when present; otherwise from the installation/deletion side. os_version corresponds to platform_version. - app_platform: set to "apple_store" for all rows. - downloads: use the aggregated downloads value or 0 if missing. - deletions: use the aggregated deletions value or 0 if missing. - Nulls and determinism: - During aggregation, null inputs do not contribute to totals. - Missing metrics are backfilled to 0. - Grouping yields one record per key in each source; the outer join yields one record per unioned key. - Original casing and spacing of app_name and os_version are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source dataset identifier taken from downloads when available, otherwise from deletions; part of the row key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Metric date taken from downloads when available, otherwise from deletions; part of the row key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant value 'apple_store' for all rows
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: App name taken from downloads when available, otherwise from deletions; original casing preserved; part of the row key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: os_version
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: OS version taken from platform_version in either source; original casing preserved; part of the row key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total downloads per key from the downloads source; nulls do not contribute; if no downloads row, output is 0; non-negative
        tests:
        - not_null
        - downloads >= 0
      - name: deletions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total deletions per key counting only delete events from the installation/deletion source; nulls do not contribute; if no deletions row, output is 0; non-negative
        tests:
        - not_null
        - deletions >= 0
    - name: int_apple_store__overview

      source_models:

When joining page_views, match to the already combined key from downloads and deletions; when joining crashes, match to the combined key across all three. - Final keys: For source_relation, date_day, and app_name, take the first non-NULL value in the order downloads → installations_deletions → page_views → crashes. - Final metrics and defaults: app_platform is set to ''apple_store''. downloads, deletions, page_views, and crashes default to 0 when the corresponding source has no data for the key or the aggregation yields NULL. - Output set: Contains the union of all keys present in any source plus the synthetic crash key; keys preserve original casing and spacing.'
      columns:

      description: Daily user lifecycle report by platform and stage with counts, rolling averages, percentages, activity mix, journey metrics, health, risk levels, ratings, recommendations, and runtime timestamp
      grain: One row per date_day per platform per user_lifecycle_stage
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_user_lifecycle_analysis
      business_logic: '- Source: intermediate.int_user_lifecycle_analysis filtered to data_quality_flag = ''Valid''. - Build daily_lifecycle_summary by (date_day, platform, user_lifecycle_stage, user_activity_level, user_status, user_value_segment): - user_count = distinct user count (by package_name). - new_users, returning_users, reactivated_users, at_risk_users = sums of their respective boolean flags. - avg_active_days_l7, avg_active_days_l30, avg_user_age_days, avg_daily_activity = simple averages that ignore NULLs (all NULL -> NULL). - high_value_users, medium_value_users, low_value_users, potential_churn_users = counts by equality to the corresponding value segment. - Build lifecycle_stage_trends by (date_day, platform, user_lifecycle_stage): - total_users_in_stage, total_new_users, total_at_risk_users = sums across subgroups. - stage_avg_activity_l7 and stage_avg_user_age = unweighted averages of subgroup averages (NULLs ignored; all NULL -> NULL). - high_value_percentage and churn_risk_percentage = 100 × (segment total ÷ total users in stage); if total users is 0 then NULL. - users_7d_avg = average of total_users_in_stage over a rolling window of the current day and 6 prior days within the same platform and stage; at series start use available days. - users_30d_ago = the total_users_in_stage value from 30 days earlier within the same platform and stage series (may be NULL if not available). - Build activity_level_analysis by (date_day, platform, user_activity_level): - users_by_activity_level, returning_users_count, reactivated_users_count = sums across subgroups. - activity_health_score = users_by_activity_level × weight (Highly Active=4, Moderately Active=3, Low Active=2, all others including Inactive=1). - Build user_journey_flow by (date_day, platform): - new_user_entries, continuous_users, user_returns, user_reactivations, dormant_users = sums of user_count where user_status matches each label. - total_tracked_users, healthy_users, converted_to_high_value also computed (not used later). - user_retention_rate = 100 × (continuous_users + user_returns) ÷ new_user_entries; if no new_user_entries then 0. - Final output: - Left join lifecycle_stage_trends to user_journey_flow by (date_day, platform). - Left join activity_level_analysis four times by (date_day, platform) for activity levels: Highly Active, Moderately Active, Low Active, Inactive; missing levels yield NULLs. - user_growth_30d_percentage = percent change vs users_30d_ago within platform and stage; if users_30d_ago is not positive or missing, return 0. - user_health_score = sum of joined activity_health_scores (missing treated as 0) divided by total_users_in_stage; if denominator is 0 then NULL. - churn_risk_level from churn_risk_percentage: >30 → High Risk; >15 → Medium Risk; otherwise Low Risk (NULL treated as otherwise). - value_creation_rating from high_value_percentage: ≥25 → Excellent; ≥15 → Good; ≥5 → Average; otherwise Poor (NULL treated as otherwise). - strategic_recommendation priority: 1) New User stage with churn risk >25 → Focus on onboarding optimization 2) Mature User stage with high value <15 → Implement value creation initiatives 3) At-risk users exceed new users → Urgent retention programs needed 4) High value ≥20 → Scale successful engagement strategies 5) Otherwise → Continue monitoring and optimization - report_generated_at = current timestamp with time zone at query runtime.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the metrics row; grouping key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Platform value from source (e.g., app store); grouping key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: user_lifecycle_stage

        description: Lifecycle stage from source; grouping key for row granularity
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_users_in_stage

        description: Sum of distinct-user counts across all subgroups for the stage on this date

        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total new user flags summed across subgroups for the stage

      - name: stage_avg_activity_l7
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unweighted average of subgroup avg_active_days_l7 for the stage; ignores NULLs; all NULL yields NULL
      - name: stage_avg_user_age
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unweighted average of subgroup avg_user_age_days for the stage; ignores NULLs; all NULL yields NULL
      - name: high_value_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of stage users in the High Value segment; NULL when total users in stage is 0
      - name: churn_risk_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage of stage users in the Potential Churn segment; NULL when total users in stage is 0
      - name: user_growth_30d_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs 30 days ago within platform and stage; returns 0 when prior value is not positive or missing
      - name: highly_active_users
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total users by activity level 'Highly Active' for the date and platform (not stage-specific); NULL if missing
      - name: moderately_active_users
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total users by activity level 'Moderately Active' for the date and platform (not stage-specific); NULL if missing
      - name: low_active_users
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total users by activity level 'Low Active' for the date and platform (not stage-specific); NULL if missing
      - name: inactive_users

        description: Total users by activity level 'Inactive' for the date and platform (not stage-specific); NULL if missing
      - name: new_user_entries

    - name: app_reporting__user_value_segmentation_report
      description: RFM-based customer segment report with global aggregation, contribution analysis, growth prioritization, tactical recommendations, and a generation timestamp
      grain: One row per customer_segment
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_user_rfm_analysis
      business_logic: '1) Start from intermediate.int_user_rfm_analysis filtered to data_quality_flag = ''Valid''. 2) customer_segment_overview: group by (customer_segment, buyer_country) and compute per group: - customer_count: distinct customers (app_id). - avg_rfm_score. - total_revenue (sum of monetary_value), avg_customer_value (average monetary_value), median_customer_value (median monetary_value). - total_estimated_clv (sum) and avg_estimated_clv (average). - Behavioral means: recency_days, frequency_count, customer_lifetime_days, avg_transaction_value. - Averages of subscription_count, purchase_count, refund_count. - Health and flags: healthy_customers (status = ''Healthy''), critical_customers (status = ''Critical''), high_value_customers (sum of is_high_value_customer), churn_risk_customers (sum of is_churn_risk), recent_customers (sum of is_recent_customer). 3) global_segment_metrics: aggregate customer_segment_overview by customer_segment: - global_customer_count: sum of per-country customer_count (a customer in multiple countries is counted in each country). - global_segment_revenue: sum of total_revenue. - global_avg_clv: unweighted average of the per-country avg_estimated_clv values. - global_avg_rfm_score: unweighted average of the per-country avg_rfm_score values. - countries_present: number of distinct buyer countries. - largest_country_customer_count: maximum customer_count observed across its countries. - total_healthy/critical/high_value/churn_risk_customers: sums of the respective counts. - health/critical/high_value/churn_risk rate percentages: 100 × summed numerator divided by summed customer_count; if the denominator is zero, return NULL; no rounding. 4) revenue_contribution_analysis: from global_segment_metrics compute: - revenue_contribution_percentage: 100 × segment revenue divided by total revenue across all segments; no rounding; if total is zero, result follows engine behavior. - revenue_rank: row number when ordering segments by revenue descending; ties receive arbitrary distinct ranks. 5) rfm_score_distribution: group rfm_base by customer_segment and compute: - avg_recency_score, avg_frequency_score, avg_monetary_score, avg_rfm_score. - premium_rfm_customers: number of rows with rfm_score ≥ 10 (rows with NULL rfm_score are not counted). - rfm_score_stddev: sample standard deviation of rfm_score; NULL if fewer than two rows. 6) segment_growth_potential: left join global_segment_metrics to revenue_contribution_analysis and rfm_score_distribution, and derive: - growth_potential: High Growth Potential if health_rate_percentage ≥ 80 and global_avg_clv > 300; Medium Growth Potential if health_rate_percentage ≥ 60 and global_avg_clv > 150; Stable Segment if health_rate_percentage ≥ 40; otherwise Declining Segment. - investment_priority by customer_segment: Champions/Loyal Customers → Maintain & Expand; Potential Loyalists → Develop & Nurture; New Customers → Onboard & Engage; At Risk → Immediate Attention; Cannot Lose Them → Win Back Campaign; Hibernating → Reactivation Program; Lost → Evaluate ROI; others → Monitor. - roi_expectation: High if global_avg_clv > 500; Medium if > 200; Low if > 50; otherwise Uncertain. - Carry revenue_contribution_percentage, revenue_rank, and use rfm_score_distribution.avg_rfm_score as segment_avg_rfm_score. 7) final_report: join segment_growth_potential to global_segment_metrics and rfm_score_distribution; select output fields and compute: - recommended_actions by customer_segment: Champions → "Reward loyalty, ask for referrals, offer new products"; Loyal Customers → "Upsell higher value products, recommend based on purchase history"; Potential Loyalists → "Offer membership/loyalty program, recommend popular products"; New Customers → "Provide onboarding support, provide education, start building relationship"; At Risk → "Send personalized emails, offer limited time offers, provide helpful resources"; Cannot Lose Them → "Reach out via phone, offer renewal discounts, provide quality customer service"; Hibernating → "Offer other product categories, special discounts, share valuable resources"; Lost → "Revive interest with relevant products, ignore otherwise"; others → "Monitor and assess". - business_impact_level with precedence: High Impact - Large revenue at risk if revenue > 10000 and health_rate_percentage < 50; else High Impact - Significant growth opportunity if revenue > 5000 and growth_potential is High Growth Potential; else Medium Impact - Substantial customer base if global_customer_count > 100; otherwise Low Impact - Monitor for changes. - report_generated_at: the query execution timestamp with time zone. 8) The final result has one row per customer_segment and is output ordered by revenue_rank, then by revenue descending (ordering does not affect the model grain).'
      columns:
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: RFM segment label from source; grouping key and unique per output row
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: global_customer_count
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum across countries of the distinct-customer counts for the segment; customers active in multiple countries are counted in each country
      - name: global_segment_revenue

      - name: global_avg_clv
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Unweighted average of the per-country average estimated CLV for the segment
      - name: revenue_contribution_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE

      - name: critical_rate_percentage

        description: ROI expectation based on global_avg_clv thresholds (>500 High, >200 Medium, >50 Low, else Uncertain)
      - name: recommended_actions
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tactical actions mapped from customer_segment labels with a default of Monitor and assess
      - name: business_impact_level

    - name: app_reporting__app_health_monitoring_report
      description: Daily app health monitoring report with platform benchmarks, rankings, alerts, and final assessment per app-day-platform
      grain: One row per date_day, app_name, platform
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_app_health_metrics
      business_logic: '- Filter source rows to data_quality_flag = ''Valid'' (base set: app_health_base). - Build daily_health_summary by selecting per-app, per-platform, per-day metrics and flags from the base: health_score, crash_rate_per_thousand, uninstall_rate_percentage, daily_average_rating, total_average_rating, rating_trend_7d, crash_rate_trend_7d, crash_rate_7d_avg, uninstall_rate_7d_avg, rating_7d_avg, crash_rate_30d_avg, installs_30d_sum, crashes_30d_sum, installs, uninstalls, total_activity, crash_count, volume_tier, health_status, and 0/1 flags: needs_immediate_attention, is_high_performing, is_declining_quality, is_stability_degrading. - Compute platform_health_comparison by grouping daily_health_summary by (date_day, platform) and deriving: total_apps = count distinct app_name; platform averages: health_score, crash_rate_7d_avg, uninstall_rate_7d_avg, rating_7d_avg; status distribution counts: excellent_apps, good_apps, average_apps, problematic_apps (Critical/High Risk/Poor Quality); attention/performance counts: high_volume_apps, apps_needing_attention, high_performing_apps; 30-day sums: platform_total_installs_30d, platform_total_crashes_30d, at_risk_installs_30d (from apps in Critical/High Risk). Aggregations ignore NULL inputs; distinct app_name eliminates duplicates. - Compute app_performance_ranking per (date_day, platform): health_rank = row_number ordered by health_score desc (higher is better); volume_rank = row_number ordered by installs_30d_sum desc; stability_rank = row_number ordered by crash_rate_30d_avg asc (lower crash rate is better); rating_rank = row_number ordered by rating_7d_avg desc. Ties are broken by engine-internal order (no explicit tie-breakers). Composite_performance_score (DOUBLE, no rounding) = 100 * [ 0.4 * (health_score / 100) + stability weight (0.3 if crash_rate_30d_avg <= 1; 0.2 if <= 5; 0.1 if <= 10; else 0) + satisfaction weight (0.2 if rating_7d_avg >= 4.5; 0.15 if >= 4.0; 0.1 if >= 3.5; 0.05 if >= 3.0; else 0) + volume weight (0.1 for High Volume; 0.075 for Medium Volume; 0.05 for Low Volume; 0.025 otherwise, covering Minimal Volume) ]. - Generate health_alerts only for rows where any is true: needs_immediate_attention = 1 OR health_score < 50 OR crash_rate_trend_7d > 5 OR rating_trend_7d < -0.3. For those rows: • alert_message and alert_severity use the first matching rule in this order: 1) crash_rate_trend_7d > 10 AND crash_rate_7d_avg > 5 → "CRITICAL: Crash rate spike detected" / CRITICAL 2) rating_trend_7d < -0.5 AND rating_7d_avg < 3.5 → "HIGH: Significant rating decline" / HIGH 3) uninstall_rate_7d_avg > 20 AND volume_tier in (''High Volume'',''Medium Volume'') → "HIGH: High uninstall rate for popular app" / HIGH 4) is_stability_degrading = 1 AND volume_tier = ''High Volume'' → "MEDIUM: Stability issues in high-volume app" / MEDIUM 5) is_declining_quality = 1 AND health_score < 60 → "MEDIUM: Quality decline trend" / MEDIUM 6) health_score < 40 → "LOW: Poor overall health score" / LOW else → NULL/NULL • recommended_action mapping (independent precedence): crash_rate_trend_7d > 10 → "Immediate investigation of crash causes required"; rating_trend_7d < -0.5 → "Review recent releases and user feedback"; uninstall_rate_7d_avg > 20 → "Analyze user retention and engagement strategies"; health_score < 40 → "Comprehensive health assessment and improvement plan needed"; else → "Continue monitoring". Rows not meeting the alert predicate produce NULL alert_* fields after the left join. - Final report: left join daily_health_summary to platform_health_comparison (on date_day, platform), app_performance_ranking (on date_day, app_name, platform), and health_alerts (on date_day, app_name, platform). Derive: • relative_platform_performance from (health_score vs platform_avg_health_score): > avg + 20 → "Above Average"; > avg → "Slightly Above Average"; > avg - 20 → "Below Average"; else → "Significantly Below Average". • overall_assessment (first matching rule): health_score >= 80 AND volume_tier = ''High Volume'' → "Star Performer - High quality, high volume"; health_score >= 70 AND crash_rate_7d_avg <= 5 → "Solid Performer - Good quality and stability"; health_score >= 50 AND volume_tier in (''High Volume'',''Medium Volume'') → "Average Performer - Monitor for improvements"; health_score < 50 OR alert_severity in (''CRITICAL'',''HIGH'') → "Needs Attention - Quality issues detected"; else → "Monitoring Required - Assess performance trends". • report_generated_at = current_timestamp (with time zone). Output one row per (date_day, app_name, platform). When rendering the query results, sort by date_day desc, platform, health_rank.'
      columns:

      - name: uninstall_rate_percentage

      - name: uninstall_rate_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE

      - name: rating_trend_7d

        tests:

      - name: crash_rate_trend_7d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 7-day change in crash rate (same unit as crash_rate_per_thousand); positive indicates worsening
      - name: installs
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily install/download count; non-negative
        tests:
        - installs >= 0
      - name: installs_30d_sum
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 30-day cumulative installs across the app; non-negative
        tests:
        - installs_30d_sum >= 0
      - name: crash_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily crash event count; non-negative
        tests:
        - crash_count >= 0
      - name: crashes_30d_sum
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 30-day cumulative crash events across the app; non-negative
        tests:
        - crashes_30d_sum >= 0
      - name: total_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total daily user activity volume (source definition); non-negative
        tests:
        - total_activity >= 0
      - name: health_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (date_day, platform) by health_score descending; 1 = best; ties broken by engine-internal order
        tests:

      - name: volume_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (date_day, platform) by installs_30d_sum descending; 1 = most installs; ties broken by engine-internal order
        tests:
        - volume_rank >= 1
      - name: stability_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (date_day, platform) by crash_rate_30d_avg ascending; 1 = lowest crash rate; ties broken by engine-internal order
        tests:
        - stability_rank >= 1
      - name: rating_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (date_day, platform) by rating_7d_avg descending; 1 = highest rating; ties broken by engine-internal order
        tests:
        - rating_rank >= 1
      - name: composite_performance_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted composite score (0–100) from health, stability, satisfaction, and volume; no rounding
        tests:
        - composite_performance_score >= 0 AND composite_performance_score <= 100
      - name: platform_avg_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Platform daily average of health_score across distinct apps; 0–100; NULL if no platform aggregate
        tests:
        - platform_avg_health_score >= 0 AND platform_avg_health_score <= 100
      - name: platform_avg_crash_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Platform daily average of crash_rate_7d_avg across apps (same unit as crash_rate_per_thousand)
        tests:
        - platform_avg_crash_rate >= 0
      - name: platform_avg_rating
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Platform daily average of rating_7d_avg across apps (1.0–5.0)
        tests:
        - platform_avg_rating >= 1.0 AND platform_avg_rating <= 5.0
      - name: platform_total_apps
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct app count per platform per day used for context
        tests:
        - platform_total_apps >= 1
      - name: platform_problematic_apps

        tests:
        - platform_problematic_apps >= 0
      - name: alert_message
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: First-matching alert text per defined precedence; NULL when no alert row joins
      - name: alert_severity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Alert severity derived from rules: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW; NULL when no alert row joins'
        tests:
        - alert_severity IN ('CRITICAL','HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW') OR alert_severity IS NULL
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Suggested remediation based on alert drivers; 'Continue monitoring' when alert predicate met but no specific driver; NULL when no alert row joins
      - name: needs_immediate_attention
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Urgency flag from source (0 = no, 1 = yes); used to include rows in alerts
        tests:
        - not_null
        - needs_immediate_attention IN (0,1)
      - name: is_high_performing
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Source flag indicating high-performing app (0/1)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - is_high_performing IN (0,1)
      - name: is_declining_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Source flag indicating declining quality trend (0/1)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - is_declining_quality IN (0,1)
      - name: is_stability_degrading
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Source flag indicating degrading stability trend (0/1)
        tests:
        - not_null
        - is_stability_degrading IN (0,1)
      - name: relative_platform_performance
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Comparison vs platform_avg_health_score: Above/Slightly Above/Below/Significantly Below Average per defined thresholds'
        tests:
        - not_null
        - relative_platform_performance IN ('Above Average','Slightly Above Average','Below Average','Significantly Below Average')
      - name: overall_assessment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Final assessment derived by ordered rules from health_score, crash_rate_7d_avg, volume_tier, and alert_severity
        tests:
        - not_null
        - overall_assessment IN ('Star Performer - High quality, high volume','Solid Performer - Good quality and stability','Average Performer - Monitor for improvements','Needs Attention - Quality issues detected','Monitoring Required - Assess performance trends')
      - name: report_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp of report creation using current_timestamp (session time zone)
        tests:
        - not_null
    - name: app_reporting__channel_effectiveness_report
      description: Daily channel effectiveness report by app, platform, and traffic source with performance metrics, category benchmarks, ROI estimates, and recommended actions
      grain: One row per date_day × app_name × platform × traffic_source
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_channel_performance
      business_logic: '1) Source filtering - Read from intermediate.int_channel_performance. - Keep only rows where data_quality_flag = ''Valid''. 2) Base features (daily_channel_performance) - Project per-row fields used downstream: date_day, app_name, platform, traffic_source, channel_category, channel_performance_tier, investment_recommendation, conversions, store_visitors, installers, conversion_rate_percentage, installers_30d_sum, visitors_30d_sum, conversion_rate_30d_avg, channel_efficiency_score, market_share_percentage, conversion_trend_7d, installer_growth_7d_percentage, volume_rank_30d, conversion_rank_30d, is_top_channel, should_scale_up, is_declining_performance, is_top_volume_source. - No additional rounding; percentages are on a 0–100 scale unless stated; AVG ignores NULLs. 3) Category aggregation (channel_category_analysis) - Group by (date_day, platform, channel_category). - Compute: - category_avg_conversion_rate = average of conversion_rate_percentage across peers in the same group. - category_avg_efficiency_score = average of channel_efficiency_score across peers in the same group. - category_30d_installers = sum of installers_30d_sum across peers in the same group. - category_high_performers = count of rows where channel_performance_tier = ''High Performer''. - category_scale_candidates = count of rows where should_scale_up = 1. - AVG ignores NULLs; flag counts add 1 for qualifying rows, else 0. 4) Top-performing channel analysis (top_performing_channels) - Filter to channel_performance_tier IN (''High Performer'',''Solid Performer'') AND installers_30d_sum > 0. - success_pattern (first-match order): a) conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 10 AND installers_30d_sum ≥ 500 → "High Volume + High Conversion" b) conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 5 AND channel_efficiency_score ≥ 70 → "Efficient Conversion" c) installers_30d_sum ≥ 1000 AND market_share_percentage ≥ 15 → "Market Leader" d) channel_efficiency_score ≥ 80 → "Highly Efficient" e) else → "Other" - scaling_recommendation (first-match order): a) should_scale_up = 1 AND conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 5 → "Immediate scale up recommended" b) channel_efficiency_score ≥ 70 AND installer_growth_7d_percentage > 0 → "Gradual scale up with monitoring" c) market_share_percentage < 5 AND conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 3 → "Test increased investment" d) else → "Continue current strategy" 5) Underperforming channel diagnostics (underperforming_channels) - Filter to (channel_performance_tier IN (''Low Performer'',''No Activity'')) OR (channel_efficiency_score < 50) OR (is_declining_performance = 1). - issue_type (first-match order): a) conversion_rate_30d_avg < 0.5 AND store_visitors > 100 → "Low Conversion Issue" b) installers_30d_sum < 10 AND conversion_rate_30d_avg > 2 → "Low Traffic Volume" c) conversion_trend_7d < -2 AND conversion_rate_30d_avg < 2 → "Declining Performance" d) channel_efficiency_score < 30 → "Overall Poor Efficiency" e) else → "Performance Below Standards" - improvement_suggestion (first-match order): a) conversion_rate_30d_avg < 1 AND store_visitors > 50 → "Optimize landing page and conversion funnel" b) installers_30d_sum < 20 AND conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 2 → "Increase traffic volume or find new audiences" c) is_declining_performance = 1 → "Investigate recent changes and competitor activity" d) channel_efficiency_score < 40 → "Consider budget reallocation or channel pause" e) else → "General optimization needed" 6) ROI estimation (roi_analysis) - For each (date_day, platform, channel_category, traffic_source): - estimated_acquisition_cost = installers_30d_sum × multiplier where multiplier = • Paid Advertising: 2.5; Social Media: 1.5; Email Marketing: 0.8; Organic Search: 0.3; else: 1.0. - estimated_user_value = installers_30d_sum × 15.0. - estimated_roi_percentage: • Paid Advertising with installers_30d_sum > 0 → ((15.0 − 2.5) / 2.5) × 100. • Social Media with installers_30d_sum > 0 → ((15.0 − 1.5) / 1.5) × 100. • Else → 0. - roi_tier (first-match): a) conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 8 AND installers_30d_sum ≥ 200 → "Excellent ROI" b) conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 5 AND installers_30d_sum ≥ 100 → "Good ROI" c) conversion_rate_30d_avg ≥ 2 AND installers_30d_sum ≥ 50 → "Acceptable ROI" d) installers_30d_sum > 0 → "Poor ROI" e) else → "No ROI Data" 7) Final assembly (final_report) - LEFT JOIN daily_channel_performance (dcp) to: • channel_category_analysis (cca) on (date_day, platform, channel_category). • top_performing_channels (tpc) on (date_day, app_name, platform, traffic_source). • underperforming_channels (uc) on (date_day, app_name, platform, traffic_source). • roi_analysis (ra) on (date_day, platform, traffic_source). - relative_category_performance compares dcp.conversion_rate_30d_avg to cca.category_avg_conversion_rate: a) > 1.5× → "Significantly Above Category Average" b) > 1.0× → "Above Category Average" c) > 0.7× → "Below Category Average" d) else → "Significantly Below Category Average" If the category average is NULL, the ELSE branch is chosen. - strategic_action (first-match): a) should_scale_up = 1 AND roi_tier = ''Excellent ROI'' → "PRIORITY: Scale up immediately with increased budget" b) channel_performance_tier = ''High Performer'' AND installer_growth_7d_percentage > 10 → "GROW: Expand successful strategy" c) is_declining_performance = 1 AND installers_30d_sum > 100 → "FIX: Investigate and resolve performance decline" d) issue_type IS NOT NULL AND market_share_percentage > 5 → "OPTIMIZE: Address identified issues" e) installers_30d_sum < 10 AND conversion_rate_30d_avg < 1 → "PAUSE: Consider stopping or major changes" f) else → "MONITOR: Continue current approach with regular review" - report_generated_at is set to the current timestamp at query execution (timezone-aware). - Final output is ordered by date_day descending, then platform, then volume_rank_30d ascending.'

      - name: conversion_rank_30d

        description: Rank by 30-day conversion rate where 1 denotes highest conversion (ties handled upstream)

      - name: category_avg_efficiency_score

      - name: estimated_roi_percentage

      - name: roi_tier
